cause_quote: The new `if (!showDebugDetails && !showUpdateDiagnostics)` branch returns the failure title and help hint before stderr can render `[openclaw] Reason:`.
user_saw: When `openclaw qr --json` refused pairing, stderr showed a generic failure and a Doctor hint instead of the specific reason.
summary: The fix routes four QR pairing refusals through the expected CLI error handler so stderr shows the specific reason while preserving the JSON stdout envelope and exit code.
reasoning: The parent of #163381 already had all four QR refusal paths, and the shared formatter printed their reason to stderr by default. The new early return skipped that reason, and the follow-up test diff in #163525 changed the existing QR JSON assertions from requiring the conflict message to requiring the generic banner and excluding the message.
